The '''BlindSide Sensor Jammer''' was a type of large-scale [[Sensor jammer/Legends|sensor jammer]] system manufactured by [[IntelStar Company|IntelStar]]. It was developed for use on [[Starship/Legends|starships]] but it was also applicable to certain ground-based strongholds. Though it could prevent accurate scans of a starship or ground base, anyone attempting to do so would be alerted to the fact their scans were being jammed.<ref name="H&S">''[[Hideouts & Strongholds]]''</ref>
